description: 住宅街のリサイクル回収場所で、女性がペットボトルを分別用ボックスに入れ、男性が古新聞を運び、子どもが空き缶を回収箱に入れている日常風景。

stage1.passage: Many communities encourage people to recycle household waste such as plastic bottles, cans, paper, and cardboard. Separating these materials correctly can reduce the amount of garbage, save useful resources, and help keep local neighborhoods clean.

q1.text: Why do many communities encourage people to separate and recycle household waste?
modelAnswers: Because recycling can reduce garbage, save resources, and help keep neighborhoods clean.
They encourage recycling because it helps reduce waste and save useful resources.

questions.text: What do you do at home to reduce waste?
modelAnswers: At home, I separate plastic bottles, cans, and paper for recycling.
I try to reduce waste by using reusable bags and bottles.
My family separates our garbage and tries not to waste food.

questions.text: Do you think recycling should be required in every community? Why or why not?
modelAnswers: Yes, I think recycling should be required because it helps reduce waste and protect the environment.
Yes. If everyone separates their garbage, communities can recycle more materials and save resources.
I think recycling rules are important because they encourage people to think about the environment.
